concepts.title: Inheritance
concepts.description: Inheritance lets a class reuse properties and behavior from a parent class.
concepts.content: Inheritance creates a parent-child relationship between classes so shared behavior is written once and reused. In JavaScript, classes can extend a base class and override methods for specialized behavior, which keeps code organized and reduces duplication.

concepts.title: Abstraction
concepts.description: Abstraction exposes a simple interface while hiding lower-level implementation details.
concepts.content: Abstraction helps developers work with clear, high-level behavior without needing to understand every internal step. In JavaScript, methods can provide public actions while private helpers keep complex details encapsulated, making code easier to use and maintain.
